verdict.rationale: No first-party doc in the pack mentions GGUF. Community evidence only implies it: Ollama is built on llama.cpp (comm-1, comm-7), users run llama.cpp-style K-quant models such as q4_K_M via 'ollama run' (comm-3), and models can be pulled straight from Hugging Face (comm-5). One commenter says Ollama stores models in a proprietary registry format with hashed filenames (comm-8), which suggests GGUF files are wrapped rather than handled natively. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of GGUF support, a documented way to import or load arbitrary local GGUF files, and direct hands-on confirmation of GGUF loading.
